name: discover-layer-connectors-full
description: The `connectors` layer's descriptor at `form: "full"` — the one form that carries the descriptor PROSE, asked for one layer at a time because the project-wide `full` discovery is REFUSED with `over-budget` on every project (`negative/discover-project-full-over-budget.json`), and the refusal's second step is exactly this request. Together the fifteen per-layer `full` vectors replay every layer, kind and field annotation the model contract ships, verbatim, which is where the shipped-prose oracle (`packages/tools/tests/test_model_contract_conformance.py`) rides: rewording an annotation in the contract is a protocol-output change, and this is the output it changes. Of this layer: the one layer whose field spelling differs from its attribute (`from`), and the `connector.from` description the shipped-prose oracle reads verbatim. Compare it with the same descriptor inside `examples/discover-project-all-layers-present.json`, which is this document with every `description` dropped and the three descriptor booleans (`optional`, `required`, `immutable`) omitted where they are `false`.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` shape of a SWCraft project: fifteen scaffolded layers, `hardware/` among them. Nothing about the response depends on which elements are in the layer: the inventory is derived from the model contract through the registry, not from the files.

layers.description: Assembly connectors, each joining one component's `provide` port to another component's `require` port over a compatible interface.

element_kinds.description: One assembly connector: it links the `from` endpoint, which must be a `provide` port, to the `to` endpoint, which must be a `require` port, and the `to` port's interface must be satisfied by the `from` port's. Connector names are unique across the layer, and so is each `(from, to)` link.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The connector's identity; the file is named from it (`connectors/{name}.yaml`, or a suffixed name when another file collides case-insensitively) and is never what identifies it. Unique across the layer, must not be empty, and immutable.

fields.name: from
fields.description: The providing endpoint: the component and the `provide` port the connector starts from. Its port's interface must satisfy the `to` port's, which the same interface always does.

fields.name: to
fields.description: The requiring endpoint: the component and the `require` port the connector delivers to. Its port's interface must be satisfied by the `from` port's, which the same interface always does.

fields.name: composition
fields.description: The name of the declared composition this connector belongs to. Absent means the root composition: the root's name is a property of the model rather than a constant, so it is resolved where the model is in hand — in the writer, in the rules and in the importer — and never written into the file as a default.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Free text about the connector. Written into the generated ARXML as the element's `DESC`, exactly as held; the empty default writes none.

element_kinds.description: One end of an assembly connector: the component or composition type that owns the port, and the port. A nested object rather than a list member, so it has no identity of its own and every field of it may change. It names the TYPE either way; the writer resolves that type to the member of it inside the connector's own composition, which is why a type may stand only once per composition.

fields.name: swc
fields.description: The name of the declared software component that owns the endpoint's port. Exactly one of `swc` and `composition` is set; this one is the endpoint of an ordinary component.

fields.name: composition
fields.description: The name of the declared composition that owns the endpoint's port, where the endpoint is a sub-composition's boundary port. Exactly one of `swc` and `composition` is set; an endpoint declaring neither, or both, is refused.

fields.name: port
fields.description: The name of a port of that component. Must not be empty; the port's existence and its direction are checked against the component.

expected.notes: The same document the default form answers with `description` restored on the layer, on every kind and on every field that declares one, and with the three descriptor booleans spelled out where the default form omits them at `false` — `optional` on the layer, `required` and `immutable` on every field. Nothing else is restored, because nothing else is left out. `baseline` is the stand-in token every vector carries; a harness replaces it with the project's own.
